get_node_id: get the SLURM node ID and node name from environment variables for the current job
get_slurm_dir: append the SLURM job ID to an input directory path for unique training artifact storage
is_submitit_available: check whether the submitit library is installed and available for SLURM job submission
test_get_node_id: test the get_node_id function to verify it extracts node info from SLURM environment variables
test_get_slurm_dir: test the get_slurm_dir function to verify it appends SLURM_JOBID to the input directory
